title: duscope_scan
description: The arguments of duscope_scan, which runs `duscope scan --save`.

root.description: The directory to scan: absolute, under one of the server's roots. Default: the server's root when it has one

attrs.description: The attributes to collect: full adds access and birth times, mode, owner and group, which duscope_stale's atime reads. Default: basic

clones.description: Count APFS clones once (true, the default) or every clone in full (false)

one_file_system.description: Stay on the root's filesystem. Default: false

max_age.description: Return a saved scan of the root taken with these options and younger than this, a number with h, d, w or y (1h), instead of scanning again. Default: always scan
